description: This is a Java source file defining the 'UserCreatedShelf' class, which extends 'Shelf'. It models a user-created bookshelf entity within a book management application, with properties for associated books and unique identifier, and includes annotations for persistence, JSON serialization, and Lombok-generated methods.

classes.name: UserCreatedShelf
classes.description: An entity class representing a user-defined shelf in the book project, extending 'Shelf', with a collection of associated books and an ID, along with custom setter, equals, and hashCode methods.

methods.name: UserCreatedShelf
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance with given shelf name and user.

methods.name: setShelfName
methods.description: Sets the shelf name after validating that it is not blank.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides the default equals method to include ID and books collection in comparison.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides hashCode to incorporate superclass hash, ID, and books collection.
